readBy: FETCH_ALL live response of 2026-10-12 (registry tier, signed in as dgsregistry@nitda.gov.ng), the 500 newest tasks and documents and the full directory
purpose: ITEM-91: whether a director's directorate tasks can be found through DGO DIGITAL OPS (option B) without changing Global Tracking Queue's indexes

directory.directorateCodes: ITD, CS, DDSD, DGO, HRM, CPS, ZOC, FMC, ONDI, RC, CCMR, and Unassigned (782)

finding: The DGO DIGITAL OPS route cannot find a directorate's tasks: 474 of the 500 newest documents carry RoutedToDSU N/A, while 497 of 500 tasks carry their routed unit (GDSUROUT). Directory directorate codes are not the same set as task unit codes, so any route needs a unit-to-directorate map. No user holds the director role.
ownerDecision: 2026-10-16 (Office of the Director-General/CEO, dgsregistry@nitda.gov.ng): option D. For go-live a director receives their own tasks, those tasks' documents and comments, and approvals, not their directorate's routed tasks. Accepted; to be built when the first director is appointed, through RoutedOrgKey (indexed) or a freed index, with a unit-to-directorate map.
